Enter the gates. Face what waits inside. Rise from E-rank to S.

How strong will you get?

games.name: [SEASON 1] Race Around The World
games.desc:
Race against other teams around the world. You will get to visit all kinds of cities, countries, and some famous landmarks. Along the way, teams will be eliminated at Checkpoints, but the first team to cross the Finish Line will win the Race Around The World!

Private servers allow you to play in Practice Mode and include an admin system that gives you more control over the game. This includes setting the legs and choosing locations for each leg before the game begins.

Please note that only the owner of the private server can use the admin system. Other players will not have access to these controls.

If you enjoy playing Race Around The World (RATW), please be sure to give the experience a thumbs up 👍

games.name: The Chosen One but i made it
games.desc:
Welcome to TCOBIMI! This is a reimagination of the game "The Chosen One" in which the player with most time gets to be the server admin, aka The Chosen One.

You can type !cmds to view all commands ingame, and you can use the "!help" for more information. There are various things to play and mess around with, including community made maps and complex custom commands!

New updates may contain various obscure bugs or glitches. It's heavily advised to report those to the group's forum. And beware of abusers... public servers are most likely very chaotic!

IMPORTANT: This game is not a modded or stolen version of "The Chosen One" by TomazDev, it's made from scratch and no assets from the original were stolen. Credits to TomazDev and a TON of music artists for their work!

Developed by Blacklight's Games

games.name: The Intruder
games.desc:
You are alone in your house. Suddenly, the phone rings. The police department issues a warning that a criminal is on the loose. Unfortunately, the criminal has a new target: YOU. Check the cameras in your room to watch his every move. He can sometimes enter your room to look for you. Hide in the closet if he does and turn off the lights. Wait until the phone regains service.

Updates: Fixed lever bug in hospital chapter.

Controls:
Flashlight: [PC: F, Gamepad: Y]
Sprint (For Mineshaft): [PC: Left-Shift, Gamepad: B]
Skill-Checks: [PC: E, Gamepad: A] 
Objective: [PC: Q] 

Inspirations: The Mandela Catalogue and Five Nights at Freddy's (also a few other games)

🔺WARNING🔺: This game includes flashing lights, loud sounds, and jumpscares.
